subject: Initial MAP worksheet & proposed close scenarios (Helios Health)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@helioshealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP worksheet & proposed close scenarios (Helios Health)

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the discovery call this morning. I pulled together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the milestones we discussed, suggested owners, and three tentative close scenarios so we can align on timing and next steps.

Quick highlights (see attached worksheet for full breakouts):
- Milestone A: POC environment & sample data handoff — proposed owner: Helios Platform (Priya) — target: 3 weeks from kickoff.
- Milestone B: Technical validation & latency/cost baseline — owner: Redwood Eng (Karthik) — target: 2 weeks after POC completion.
- Milestone C: Procurement & contract sign-off — owner: Helios Procurement — target options included (fast / normal / extended).

I included three close scenarios in the worksheet:
1) Aggressive (6 weeks) — requires expedited procurement + dedicated pilot window.
2) Typical (10–12 weeks) — aligns with standard procurement and 2-week POC.
3) Conservative (16+ weeks) — if procurement needs approvals or additional security review.

Ask: can you confirm the Helios stakeholders who should be owners for the first two milestones (POC handoff and technical validation)? I’ve tentatively listed Priya for data handoff and Alex for program sponsorship but want your confirmation before I circulate a version to procurement.

Next steps I propose after you confirm stakeholders:
- Lock in a kickoff date (I put three date options in the worksheet).
- Redwood will provision a pilot instance and share a deployment checklist.
- Schedule a tech sync with your platform team (30–45m) to agree on test data and success criteria.

Attachment: Helios_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (MAP worksheet — milestones, owners, dependencies, date options)

Thanks — looking forward to closing on a kickoff date.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@helioshealth.com>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@helioshealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T18:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP worksheet & proposed close scenarios (Helios Health)

Thanks Soojin — this looks useful and much appreciated. I reviewed the worksheet with Priya and a couple of quick notes: 

- Stakeholders: confirmed — Priya will be the data handoff owner, I’ll remain the exec sponsor. Please add Greg Patel (greg.patel@helioshealth.com) from Infrastructure as the technical on-call for the POC.
- Timeline: the ‘typical’ scenario (10–12 weeks) is our preference unless there’s a compelling reason to accelerate. Procurement needs at least 3 weeks for contract review — they asked to loop in Legal early.
- Security: we’ll need the security profile PDF you mentioned; can you attach Redwood’s SOC 2 / basic network requirements? That will speed Legal sign-off.

We can confirm a kickoff next week. How does 2026-08-17 or 2026-08-19 look for you and Karthik?

Alex
Head of Platform | Helios Health
alex.j@helioshealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0142

I also updated the worksheet to add Greg Patel as Infrastructure owner and moved the default scenario to the Typical (10–12 weeks).

- Priya: can you confirm which dataset subset we should use for the POC (anonymized patient activity logs vs. simulated data)? The POC checklist in the worksheet assumes anonymized logs.

I’ll circulate an updated MAP (v1.1) after confirmation and send a calendar invite for 2026-08-19 10:00 AM ET with a short agenda (POC scope, success criteria, next 2 weeks tasks).

Subject: Re: Initial MAP worksheet & proposed close scenarios (Helios Health)

Looping in a quick note from engineering side — thanks for including me on this. Two dependencies to call out so they’re front-and-center on the MAP: 

1) Data access SLA — for the POC we need a stable staging endpoint (S3 / RDS) and credentials at least 48 hours prior to kickoff. If Helios procurement prefers a limited data agreement in the POC window, we can run with simulated data but that will expand validation time by ~1 week.

2) Network egress / firewall rules — Greg, if you can confirm the public IP ranges or VPN details we should expect, we’ll pre-configure the pilot instance to avoid late-day blockers.

Monica — if this goes to typical timeline, please flag procurement touchpoints we need to surface in the MAP (purchase order lead times, redlines we commonly see). I’ll take ownership of the technical validation milestone.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales Director (Engagements) | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
